targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (COALESCE(interface_id::text, agent_host || ':' || COALESCE("ifIndex"::text, '0'), host)) COALESCE(if_oper_status, "ifOperStatus"::int) AS oper_status FROM interface_performance_metrics ORDER BY COALESCE(interface_id::text, agent_host || ':' || COALESCE("ifIndex"::text, '0'), host), time DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE oper_status = 1) AS value FROM latest;

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (COALESCE(interface_id::text, agent_host || ':' || COALESCE("ifIndex"::text, '0'), host)) COALESCE(if_oper_status, "ifOperStatus"::int) AS oper_status FROM interface_performance_metrics ORDER BY COALESCE(interface_id::text, agent_host || ':' || COALESCE("ifIndex"::text, '0'), host), time DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE oper_status = 2) AS value FROM latest;

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (COALESCE(interface_id::text, agent_host || ':' || COALESCE("ifIndex"::text, '0'), host)) COALESCE(if_admin_status, "ifAdminStatus"::int) AS admin_status, COALESCE(if_oper_status, "ifOperStatus"::int) AS oper_status FROM interface_performance_metrics ORDER BY COALESCE(interface_id::text, agent_host || ':' || COALESCE("ifIndex"::text, '0'), host), time DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admin_status = 1 AND oper_status = 2) AS value FROM latest;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(interface_id::text, agent_host || ':' || COALESCE("ifIndex"::text, '0'), host)) AS value FROM interface_performance_metrics;

WITH samples AS (SELECT p.time, p.agent_host, p."sysName", p."ifIndex", p."ifDescr", p."ifInOctets", LAG(p."ifInOctets") OVER (PARTITION BY p.agent_host, p."ifIndex" ORDER BY p.time) AS previous_value, LAG(p.time) OVER (PARTITION BY p.agent_host, p."ifIndex" ORDER BY p.time) AS previous_time FROM interface_performance_metrics p WHERE $__timeFilter(p.time) AND p."ifInOctets" IS NOT NULL) SELECT s.time AS time, GREATEST((s."ifInOctets" - s.previous_value) * 8.0 / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.time - s.previous_time), 0), 0) AS value, COALESCE(d.hostname, s.agent_host, s."sysName") || ' ' || s."ifDescr" || ' RX' AS metric FROM samples s LEFT JOIN devices d ON d.ip_address = NULLIF(s.agent_host, '')::inet WHERE s.previous_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.time;

WITH samples AS (SELECT p.time, p.agent_host, p."sysName", p."ifIndex", p."ifDescr", p."ifOutOctets", LAG(p."ifOutOctets") OVER (PARTITION BY p.agent_host, p."ifIndex" ORDER BY p.time) AS previous_value, LAG(p.time) OVER (PARTITION BY p.agent_host, p."ifIndex" ORDER BY p.time) AS previous_time FROM interface_performance_metrics p WHERE $__timeFilter(p.time) AND p."ifOutOctets" IS NOT NULL) SELECT s.time AS time, GREATEST((s."ifOutOctets" - s.previous_value) * 8.0 / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.time - s.previous_time), 0), 0) AS value, COALESCE(d.hostname, s.agent_host, s."sysName") || ' ' || s."ifDescr" || ' TX' AS metric FROM samples s LEFT JOIN devices d ON d.ip_address = NULLIF(s.agent_host, '')::inet WHERE s.previous_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.time;

SELECT p.time AS time, COALESCE(p."ifInErrors", p.rx_errors_delta, 0) + COALESCE(p."ifOutErrors", p.tx_errors_delta, 0) AS value, COALESCE(d.hostname, p.agent_host, p."sysName") || ' ' || COALESCE(p."ifDescr", i.if_descr, 'interface') AS metric FROM interface_performance_metrics p LEFT JOIN interfaces i ON i.id = p.interface_id LEFT JOIN devices d ON d.id = i.device_id OR d.ip_address = NULLIF(p.agent_host, '')::inet WHERE $__timeFilter(p.time) ORDER BY p.time;

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (COALESCE(p.interface_id::text, p.agent_host || ':' || COALESCE(p."ifIndex"::text, '0'), p.host)) p.* FROM interface_performance_metrics p ORDER BY COALESCE(p.interface_id::text, p.agent_host || ':' || COALESCE(p."ifIndex"::text, '0'), p.host), p.time DESC) SELECT COALESCE(d.hostname, l.agent_host, l."sysName", l.host) AS device, COALESCE(l."ifDescr", i.if_descr, 'interface') AS interface, COALESCE(l."ifSpeed", i.speed) AS speed, COALESCE(l.if_admin_status, l."ifAdminStatus"::int) AS admin_state, COALESCE(l.if_oper_status, l."ifOperStatus"::int) AS oper_state, COALESCE(l.rx_errors_delta, l."ifInErrors"::bigint) AS rx_errors, COALESCE(l.tx_errors_delta, l."ifOutErrors"::bigint) AS tx_errors, l.time AS last_update FROM latest l LEFT JOIN interfaces i ON i.id = l.interface_id LEFT JOIN devices d ON d.id = i.device_id OR d.ip_address = NULLIF(l.agent_host, '')::inet ORDER BY device, interface;

SELECT p.time AS time, p.optical_rx_dbm AS value, d.hostname || ' ' || i.if_descr || ' RX' AS metric FROM interface_performance_metrics p JOIN interfaces i ON i.id = p.interface_id JOIN devices d ON d.id = i.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.time) AND p.optical_rx_dbm IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.time;

SELECT p.time AS time, p.optical_tx_dbm AS value, d.hostname || ' ' || i.if_descr || ' TX' AS metric FROM interface_performance_metrics p JOIN interfaces i ON i.id = p.interface_id JOIN devices d ON d.id = i.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(p.time) AND p.optical_tx_dbm IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.time;
